description: This Java class provides utility methods for reading from and writing to network sockets and servlet streams, including handling HTTP input streams and socket data conversion.

classes.name: IOStreamUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling IO streams, including reading from sockets and servlet requests, and writing to servlet responses.

methods.name: readHttpInputStreamToString(Socket socket)
methods.description: Reads HTTP input stream from a socket and converts it to a String, handling content length if specified.

methods.name: readSocketToString(Socket socket)
methods.description: Reads all data from a socket input stream and converts it to a String.

methods.name: readHttpInputStreamToString(ServletRequest request)
methods.description: Reads HTTP request input stream from a ServletRequest and converts it to a String, with logging on IOException.

methods.name: writeToOutputStream(byte[] data, ServletResponse response)
methods.description: Writes byte array data to a ServletResponse output stream, with error logging.
